title: What are some powerful, thought provoking, contemplative films like Paris, Texas, Blue Velvet, could be art house too, also like these below:

commenti.body:
Definitely check out Peter Weir’s Picnic at Hanging Rock. The pace is slow but there’s such an underlying tension and almost creepiness to the whole thing, even though it’s not exactly a horror movie.

Incredible use of color as well.

Have you seen A Ghost Story (2017) with Casey Affleck? 

Or perhaps Manchester by the Sea (2016), also with Casey Affleck?

Or maybe you would like The Assassination of Jesse James by the Coward Robert Ford (2007), also with Casey Affleck?

I have seen Manchester by the sea which was an interesting experience, maybe not the one I needed at that time, still it has remained in my heart for some time and I keep thinking about it.


I love Paul Thomas Anderson films a lot and also David Lynch which I absolutely adore.
You might like A Ghost Story.
Thank you for the suggestion, are there any other films you could think of that could be thought provoking? Thank you.
Have you tried Ocean’s Twelve and American Pie, each featuring Casey Affleck?

Two films that really affected me were Big Fish and Incsption. 

They both argue major philosophies, like epistemology, realism versus idealism, hermeneutics,,,

In simple words, they discuss which one is more important, the actual event that happened, or your perception of it. 

Inception ending is open to interpretation, but big fish has a solid message. 

Also, I really liked Mr.nobody

Antonioni: The Travelling Players

Herzog: Mr Death 1999

Godard: Hi Mom!

Bergman: The Fifth Seal

Tarkovsky: Mother and Son

Bresson: Colossal Youth

Kubrick: Deep End

Buñuel: Daisies 1966

Do you like Hal Ashby films? Some of PT Anderson's films kind of remind me his films. I just watched The Last Detail (1973). It's a really solid film that makes you think, but not in a Lynchian sort of way. More like in a... what do we owe each other sort of way. Being There is top tier too.
